name: nuclear-grade
description: Nuclear-grade context engineering — the repository as its own Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: nuclear-grade
plugins.description: Risk-graded context-engineering skills, command prompts, and change-record templates. No hooks are configured, so nothing runs automatically; the bundled ng CLI is included for repo-side use (run from a checkout) and runs nothing on its own.

plugins.name: nuclear-grade-guard
plugins.description: Opt-in blocking gate. Registers one PreToolUse hook that denies agent edits to trust surfaces and asks a human before force pushes, tags, releases, publishes, and risky deletes. Needs python3 on PATH. See HOOKS.md.
